quran.why: Surat al-Ikhlas, first half: He is Allah, One, the Eternal Refuge / Surat al-Ikhlas, second half: He neither begets nor is born, none is equal to Him
Your god is one God, no deity but Him
Ayat al-Kursi: no deity but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer
Had there been other gods besides Allah, heavens and earth would be ruined
Every messenger was sent with: no deity but Me, so worship Me

hadith.why: Allah's right upon His servants: worship Him alone and associate nothing with Him
Happiest with the Prophet's intercession is who says la ilaha illallah sincerely
The highest branch of faith is the declaration la ilaha illallah

duas.why: Daily tahlil: none worthy of worship but Allah alone, without partner
Morning/evening testimony calling creation to witness that Allah is One

quran.why: To Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them
End of al-Hashr: a sequence of Allah's names; to Him belong the best names

cut.ar: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ ۖ أَيًّۭا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
cut.en: Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names."
cut.ur: کہہ دو کہ تم (خدا کو) الله (کے نام سے) پکارو یا رحمٰن (کے نام سے) جس نام سے پکارو اس کے سب اچھے نام ہیں۔

quran.why: Call upon Allah or ar-Rahman; to Him belong the best names
The First, the Last, the Ascendant, the Intimate

cut.ar: لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
cut.en: There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
cut.ur: اس جیسی کوئی چیز نہیں۔ اور وہ دیکھتا سنتا ہے

quran.why: There is nothing like unto Him; the Hearing, the Seeing

hadith.why: Allah has ninety-nine names; whoever memorizes them enters Paradise
The One you call is not deaf or absent: All-Hearing, Ever Near
Allah will roll up the heavens and say: I am the King (al-Malik)

duas.why: Asking Allah by every name He has named Himself with
Invoking Him as al-Mannan, Badi' as-Samawat, Dhul-Jalal wal-Ikram, al-Hayy al-Qayyum
Asking by His names al-Wahid, al-Ahad, as-Samad, al-Ghafur, ar-Rahim

quran.why: Believers believe in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers
Allah made the angels messengers with wings, two, three or four
The angels prostrate to Allah, are not arrogant, fear Him and do as commanded
Noble recording angels appointed over you who know what you do
The angel of death entrusted with you takes your soul
The throne-bearing angels glorify Allah and ask forgiveness for the believers

hadith.why: Angels were created from light
The Prophet saw Jibril with six hundred wings
No space of four fingers in heaven without an angel in prostration
The size of one of the angels who carry the Throne

quran.why: The Book in which there is no doubt, guidance for the God-conscious
Allah sent down the Quran and will guard it
The Quran guides to what is most upright
Mankind and jinn together could not produce its like
A blessed Book revealed so people reflect on its verses
The Quran has been made easy for remembrance

hadith.why: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it
Each letter recited earns a good deed multiplied tenfold
The skilled reciter is with the noble angel-scribes; the one who struggles gets two rewards
The Quran will come as an intercessor for its companions

duas.why: Asking Allah to make the Quran the spring of the heart and light of the chest

quran.why: Believe in what was given to Ibrahim, Musa, Isa and all prophets, without distinction
A messenger was sent to every nation: worship Allah, avoid false gods
Revelation came to Muhammad as it came to Nuh, Ibrahim and the prophets after them
Some messengers' stories are told, others not; sent as bringers of good news and warners
Those who believe in all His messengers without discriminating will be rewarded

hadith.why: Every prophet was given signs through which people believed
Adam was a prophet; the messengers numbered three hundred and fifteen
A prophet struck by his people wiped his blood and prayed for their forgiveness
Every prophet Allah sent tended sheep

quran.why: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the prophets
Sent only as a mercy to the worlds
A Messenger from among you, grieved by your suffering, kind and merciful
You are of a great moral character
In the Messenger of Allah is an excellent example
Allah and His angels send blessings on the Prophet; believers are told to do the same

hadith.why: No one truly believes until the Prophet is dearer to him than father, children and all people
Do not exaggerate in praising me; call me the slave of Allah and His Messenger
Whoever obeys me enters Paradise; whoever disobeys me has refused
The miser is the one who hears his name and does not send blessings on him

duas.why: The Ibrahimic salawat on the Prophet

quran.why: Everything was created by decree
Every calamity is written before it happens, so do not despair or exult
Nothing will strike us except what Allah has decreed for us
No disaster strikes except by Allah's permission
The keys of the unseen; not a leaf falls but He knows it, all in a clear record
You do not will except that Allah wills

hadith.why: Allah decreed the destinies of creation fifty thousand years before the heavens and earth
Everything is decreed, even incapacity and capacity
Do not say 'if only'; say Allah has decreed and what He wills He does
If the nation gathered to benefit or harm you, only what Allah wrote would happen

duas.why: Qaddar Allahu wa ma sha'a fa'al: said when something disliked happens
None can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold

quran.why: Allah does not forgive association with Him but forgives what is less
Luqman to his son: do not associate with Allah; shirk is great injustice

cut.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍۢ
cut.en: Indeed, he who associates others with Allah - Allah has forbidden him Paradise, and his refuge is the Fire. And there are not for the wrongdoers any helpers.
cut.ur: جو شخص خدا کے ساتھ شرک کرے گا خدا اس پر بہشت حرام کر دے گا اور اس کا ٹھکانہ دوزخ ہے اور ظالموں کا کوئی مددگار نہیں

quran.why: Whoever associates others with Allah, Paradise is forbidden to him
Revealed to every prophet: if you associate, your deeds become worthless
Whoever associates with Allah is as if he fell from the sky
Do not invoke besides Allah what neither benefits nor harms you

hadith.why: The gravest sin: setting up an equal to Allah while He created you
Whoever meets Allah associating partners with Him enters Hellfire
What the Prophet feared most for us: minor shirk, showing off
Whoever swears by other than Allah has committed shirk

duas.why: Refuge from committing shirk knowingly and forgiveness for it unknowingly
Refuge from the evil and shirk of the devil

cut.ar: وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا۟ لَمَنِ ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَٰقٍۢ
cut.en: But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allah. And the people learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But the Children of Israel certainly knew that whoever purchased the magic would not have in the Hereafter any share.
cut.ur: اور خدا کے حکم کے سوا وہ اس (جادو) سے کسی کا کچھ بھی نہیں بگاڑ سکتے تھے۔ اور کچھ ایسے (منتر) سیکھتے جو ان کو نقصان ہی پہنچاتے اور فائدہ کچھ نہ دیتے۔ اور وہ جانتے تھے کہ جو شخص ایسی چیزوں (یعنی سحر اور منتر وغیرہ) کا خریدار ہوگا، اس کا آخرت میں کچھ حصہ نہیں۔

quran.why: Magic harms only by Allah's permission, and whoever buys it has no share in the Hereafter

cut.ar: إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
cut.en: What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is.
cut.ur: جو کچھ انہوں نے بنایا ہے (یہ تو) جادوگروں کے ہتھکنڈے ہیں اور جادوگر جہاں جائے فلاح نہیں پائے گا

quran.why: What they crafted is a magician's trick; the magician will not succeed
Musa: what you brought is magic; Allah will expose its worthlessness
Surat al-Falaq, first half: refuge in the Lord of daybreak from all evil / Surat al-Falaq, second half: refuge from those who blow on knots and from the envier

hadith.why: Magic is one of the seven destructive sins
Not one of us who practises sorcery or soothsaying or has it done; believing a soothsayer is disbelief
Whoever goes to a fortune-teller and believes him, his prayer is not accepted for forty nights
The Prophet sought refuge from the jinn and the evil eye, then used only al-Falaq and an-Nas
Jibril's ruqyah for the Prophet, including from the envier's eye

duas.why: Evil eye is real: ask for blessing when you admire something
The Prophet's protection for al-Hasan and al-Husayn from every evil eye
Al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas three times morning and evening

quran.why: Every soul will taste death; full recompense on the Day of Resurrection
The death you flee from will meet you

cut.ar: أَيْنَمَا تَكُونُوا۟ يُدْرِككُّمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنتُمْ فِى بُرُوجٍۢ مُّشَيَّدَةٍۢ
cut.en: Wherever you may be, death will overtake you, even if you should be within towers of lofty construction.
cut.ur: تم کہیں رہو موت تو تمہیں آ کر رہے گی خواہ بڑے بڑے محلوں میں رہو

quran.why: Death will overtake you even in lofty towers
The intoxication of death brings the truth
Spend before death comes; Allah will not delay a soul when its time comes
Everyone on earth perishes; only the Face of your Lord remains

hadith.why: Family, wealth and deeds follow the dead; only deeds remain
Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him
Prompt the dying to say la ilaha illallah
Be in this world like a stranger; take from your life for your death

duas.why: The dying person's dua: forgive me, have mercy on me, join me to the highest companions
Whose last words are la ilaha illallah enters Paradise
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, said at a loss

cut.ar: ٱلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّۭا وَعَشِيًّۭا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلْعَذَابِ
cut.en: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
cut.ur: آتش (جہنم) کہ صبح وشام اس کے سامنے پیش کئے جاتے ہیں۔ اور جس روز قیامت برپا ہوگی (حکم ہوگا کہ) فرعون والوں کو نہایت سخت عذاب میں داخل کرو

quran.why: Pharaoh's people are exposed to the Fire morning and evening before the Hour
Allah keeps the believers firm with the firm word in this life and the Hereafter
At death the disbeliever asks to return; behind them is a barrier (barzakh) until resurrection
He causes his death and provides him a grave, then resurrects him
Competition for increase diverts you until you visit the graves

hadith.why: The Muslim questioned in the grave testifies to the shahadah; the meaning of 14:27
The grave is the first stage of the Hereafter
The dead are shown their place in Paradise or Hell morning and evening
Two people punished in their graves for urine and malicious gossip

duas.why: Refuge from the punishment of the grave, said before ending the prayer
After burial: O Allah forgive him, O Allah make him firm
Greeting the people of the graves when visiting

quran.why: The convulsion of the Hour: nursing mothers forget their infants
The Horn is blown, all fall dead, then it is blown again and they stand
People are shown their deeds; an atom's weight of good or evil will be seen
The scales of justice are set up; no soul is wronged
The record leaves nothing small or great
Fear a Day when you return to Allah and every soul is repaid

hadith.why: No one moves until asked about his life, knowledge, wealth and body
People gathered barefoot, naked and uncircumcised
Allah will speak to each person with no interpreter between them
People will stand before the Lord of the worlds, some submerged in sweat to their ears

duas.why: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants

quran.why: Hasten to a garden as wide as the heavens and earth
Gardens with rivers and pleasant dwellings; Allah's approval is greater
No soul knows what comfort of the eyes is hidden for them
Gardens of Firdaus as lodging; they will never want to leave
Rivers in the Gardens of Pleasure; their call is Subhanaka Allahumma
The righteous are driven to Paradise in groups and greeted with peace

hadith.why: Prepared for the righteous: what no eye has seen and no ear has heard
The people of Paradise will be healthy, alive, young and at ease forever
A bow's length in Paradise is better than all the sun rises on
Allah's pleasure upon the people of Paradise, never to be displeased

duas.why: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire

quran.why: Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire fuelled by people and stones
Skins roasted through are replaced so they taste the punishment

cut.ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا ۚ وَإِن يَسْتَغِيثُوا۟ يُغَاثُوا۟ بِمَآءٍۢ كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَشْوِى ٱلْوُجُوهَ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا
cut.en: Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place.
cut.ur: ہم نے ظالموں کے لئے دوزخ کی آگ تیار کر رکھی ہے جس کی قناتیں ان کو گھیر رہی ہوں گی۔ اور اگر فریاد کریں گے تو ایسے کھولتے ہوئے پانی سے ان کی دادرسی کی جائے گی (جو) پگھلے ہوئے تانبے کی طرح (گرم ہوگا اور جو) مونہوں کو بھون ڈالے گا (ان کے پینے کا) پانی بھی برا اور آرام گاہ بھی بری

quran.why: A fire whose walls surround them; water like murky oil scalds faces
Hell inhales and boils, almost bursting with rage
In Hell they neither die nor is the torment lightened
The believers' dua: avert from us the punishment of Hell

hadith.why: Worldly fire is one seventieth of Hellfire
The least punished in Hell wears sandals of fire that make his brain boil
A stone thrown into Hell took seventy years to reach its bottom
Hellfire is surrounded by desires, Paradise by hardships

duas.why: Rabbana atina: protect us from the punishment of the Fire
Asking for Paradise and refuge from the Fire
